info.title: Muse Relay API
info.description: Relay inboxes linked by pasting a connection prompt into the chosen Muse conversation. muse_id identifies the inbox, not a Meta AI account. Inbox-scoped sender keys authenticate the common plain-text API; anonymous delivery is disabled.

schema.description: Legacy structured API. id is optional; server generates it when omitted. Explicit IDs preserve the existing idempotent contract.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional automatic retry key. Reuse only for the same uncertain request. No user-managed message ID is needed.

schema.description: UTF-8 nonblank natural-language text. Encoded message envelope must be <=262144 bytes.

409.description: Same retry key used with different text

503.description: Storage unavailable; retry with same automatic key
